about: Frontend #364: cases M-106..M-113 of the pinned specialist-memory cases (Architecture #597, v2 §5l.15-5l.17) -> the test that proves each. Server tests ran failing on mine first (11 of 14; M-111/M-112/M-113 already held and stay as guards). Page tests marked notBuilt are Task 2's to turn into it(...). Checked by tests/unit/department-specialists-explorer-case-map.test.ts.
